title: Lightweight Optimized
description: Amazing graphics, fast and optimized performance and useful features packed together!
body:
**This modpack is a precision-engineered toolkit designed to maximize your FPS and streamline your technical gameplay while maintaining a clean, modern aesthetic.**

ℹ️*Performance benchmarks and tests were conducted on* Fabric Minecraft **1.20.1** *and above*
___
# 📥Installation:
This pack combines the industry's best optimization mods with essential utility tweaks as well as ressource packs and lightweight. It is designed to ensure that you get the highest possible frame rates without sacrificing graphical quality.

# ✨Features:
## 🚀Ultimate Performance:
### Rendering Overhaul:
⚡Powered by **Sodium** and **ImmediatelyFast** to provide a massive boost to frame rates and significantly reduce stuttering during gameplay.
### Memory & Logic Optimization:
🧠Includes **Lithium** and **FerriteCore** to optimize game physics and reduce memory usage, allowing the game to run smoother on lower-end hardware.
### Entity Culling:
🚫Uses **Entity Culling** to skip rendering mobs and players that aren't in your direct line of sight, further boosting performance in crowded servers.

## 🛠️Advanced Utility:
### Xaero's World & Minimap:
🗺️Fully integrated maps for the best navigation experience.
### Tweakeroo & MiniHUD:
📊Includes **Tweakeroo** for various client-side tweaks and **MiniHUD** to display critical info like coordinates, FPS, and biome without cluttering your screen.
### Freecam:
📹**Freecam** is included for better perspective and checking out your things and stuff from any angle and POV.

## 🎨Quality of Life:
### Zoomify:
🔍A highly customizable zoom mod to help you scout the terrain or spy on enemies from a distance.
### ModernFix & Debugify:
🔧Fixes hundreds of vanilla bugs and optimizes loading times so you spend less time at the loading screen and more time having fun playing.
### No Chat Reports:
🛡️Includes **No Chat Reports** to maintain your privacy and security while playing on various servers.

## ⚡Other Included Tweaks:
- **Sodium Extra & Options:** More granular control over video settings.
- **Iris Shaders:** Support for high-performance shaders.
- **FastQuit:** Return to the main menu instantly while the world saves in the background.
- **Dynamic FPS:** Reduces resource usage when the game is tabbed out.
- *etc...*  

# 🛠️Versioning:
This modpackpack uses the following versioning system:
- **Base modpack:** standard versioning
  - -> *e.g.* **1.0.0, 2.4.3,...**
